findings.write_gap: m_driver.mere __fd_flush_w waits with -1 and direct write paths do not apply @__io_timeout
findings.linux_baseline: Math.cbrt last bits; recvmsg MSG_CMSG_CLOEXEC result bit; both compared with previous native baseline
findings.gem_environment: Old shared Ruby3.2.2 home was removed; private sidekiq-pro recovery must be audited rather than silently dropping the sample
findings.cbrt: Ruby math.c applies one Newton refinement only under __GLIBC__; native direct libc cbrt omitted it.
findings.recvmsg: Ruby ancdata.c requests MSG_CMSG_CLOEXEC when available and returns the resulting bit, including when no controls are received. Native metadata omits it.
findings.timeout_reference: Ruby accepts false at assignment then rejects it as interval when used; rejects negative/Inf/NaN/Complex at assignment. write/syswrite timeout message differs from buffered flush. Match actual reference behavior.
findings.extra_linux: The full Linux corpus exposed the same unknown-errno constructor prefix issue in witnesses203/204; fixed the platform prefix and will continue the full run.
findings.write_contract: Reference probes distinguish direct vs flush timeout messages, retain buffers on flush/close timeout, leave sync= buffered data pending, keep syswrite raw, use minimum0 and timeoutnil for scheduler hooks, and preserve custom divmod timeout identity.
findings.reference_limit: Pinned reference itself exceeds an outer2s bound when a blocking inherited pipe is only partially writable and syswrite requests65536bytes. Do not claim preemption of a blocking kernel syscall beyond Ruby behavior.
findings.reference_environment: Local Docker image had json3.1.0 installed above the Ruby4.0.9 default json2.18.0; final full Linux comparison uses only that reference installation default gem path.
findings.write_fixture: On Linux, draining only65536bytes of a filled UNIX socket can remain below its writable low-water mark; drain queued data to EAGAIN for the readiness recovery witness.
